Available tools:
- hubspot_get_calendar_events: connect to hubspot account through api calls. Get events from the calendar. The endpoint supports filtering to get the specific events you want.
- zoho_creator_view_records: All Zoho Creator Rest Methods. Replace https://zohocreator.p.rapidapi.com/ with https://creator.zoho.com/api/ if you're using native system
- send_message_to_multiple_numbers: This API is useful to send a branded sms to multiple numbers"
